name: The Vaar
description: An old myth of beings who fled the Eldrazi into a virtual world, the Hylderhigh, and whose knowledge persists in physical nodes.

timeline.summary: A voice declares escape incorrect and that from the many there must be one Vaar; Farakatolar realizes the orb is a node of the Vaar's knowledge.
timeline.quote: The Vaar. It is an old myth.

relations.note: a node connected to the Vaar's ancient knowledge
relations.quote: Solid, physical spaces connected to the vastness of the Vaar's ancient knowledge.

relations.note: the Vaar ran from the Eldrazi
relations.quote: The Vaar who ran from the Eldrazi.
